message.content: In December, Los Angeles typically enjoys mild, Mediterranean‑climate weather. The average daily high is about **15 °C (59 °F)**, while the average low drops to roughly **10 °C (50 °F)**. These figures are averages over the month, so you’ll see days ranging from the mid‑50s to the low‑70s °F (13–22 °C) during the day and cooler nights in the 40s °F (4–9 °C).
